purpose: Content identities of governed research datasets. Read by scripts/research_gate.py. Documentation and governance only; nothing in the money path reads it.
rule: From the effective date, a registration must name a dataset ID and SHA-256 from this file in parameters['dataset'], and its runner must call research_gate.verify_dataset() and load bars only from the path it returns, before computing any result. See docs/datasets/README.md.

evidence_classes.historical_in_sample: Historical research data. Every dataset below, and every name in research.DATASETS except 'forward', is contaminated for the frozen candidate: it may reject an idea, never accept one.
evidence_classes.paper_operational: Records the live paper account produces (data/autotrade-audit.jsonl, equity readings, fills) from research.FORWARD_START = 2026-09-11. Operational evidence only - never research data, never validation. Sessions from the freeze to the last embargoed session are paper-operational and NOT Clean OOS, even though research.DATASETS['forward'] labels the account from 2026-09-11 'clean' (see CONF-10).
evidence_classes.clean_oos: Only sessions accepted by the Phase 4 recorder into data/forward-evaluation.jsonl, beginning at forward.first_clean_session() - projected 2026-10-12 - after the 20-session embargo. Nothing earlier, and nothing outside that record, is Clean OOS.
